"""Freeze complete source owners and exact old companions for reported commands/copulas."""
import copy,gzip,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
from native_lmf import array,entry,verify_native_lmf
source=json.load(open('/tmp/klem-reported-command-deoni-discovery-corrected.json'))
prior=json.load(gzip.open('/tmp/klem-reported-deoni-source-preparation.json.gz'))
ids=set(source['complete_native_entries']);native={};original={};hashes={}
for path in sorted((ROOT/'data/dictionaries/krdict/json').glob('*.json')):
 raw_bytes=path.read_bytes();hashes[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest()
 for raw in array(json.loads(raw_bytes)['LexicalResource']['Lexicon']['LexicalEntry']):
  if 'krdict:'+raw['val'] not in ids:continue
  value=entry(raw)
  if value['id'] not in ids:continue
  assert value['id'] not in native;native[value['id']]=value;original[value['id']]=raw
assert native==source['complete_native_entries'] and hashes==prior['source_hashes']
projection={'LexicalResource':{'Lexicon':{'LexicalEntry':[]}}}
for ident in sorted(ids):
